caption: A loaded toolbox resting on a crushed cardboard box in a garage is lifted away, and the box stays crumpled.

sa.check: A toolbox rests on a crushed cardboard box in a garage.
The box is already crushed at the start.
The lift comes first and the box stays as it was.

pc.expect: The box keeps its caved-in top and buckled sides after the weight is gone.
pc.fail: It springs back to shape; or it collapses further with nothing on it; or it re-inflates slowly.

pc.expect: The cardboard holds its creases: the box is crumpled, neither torn to shreds nor rigid.
pc.fail: The box turns out rigid and un-dented when the toolbox lifts; or it shreds; or it flows.

pc.expect: The box stays where it is.
pc.fail: It slides; or lifts with the toolbox; or jumps.

pc.expect: The toolbox rises only as it is lifted, and the box stays on the floor.
pc.fail: The toolbox floats; or the box rises; or the toolbox drops back.

pc.expect: One box and one toolbox keep their number.
pc.fail: The box vanishes or a second appears; or the toolbox passes through the box; or the box turns into another object.

pc.expect: The box's printing, the toolbox and the garage stay the same.
pc.fail: The printing changes; or the toolbox changes colour; or the garage rearranges.
